title: Tiếng Anh 11 – Global Success – Sách học sinh
edition: Tái bản lần thứ ba (third reprint)
publisher: Nhà xuất bản Giáo dục Việt Nam / Pearson
scope: All ten dedicated IV Speaking sections, including preparation and reporting tasks. Oral prompts in Reading, Listening, Language, Communication/Culture, Projects and Reviews are outside this bank.
review: OCR assisted transcription, then all 19 Speaking page images inspected. English, Vietnamese, hint, model and goal reviewed together editorially; no claim of automated linguistic validation. Exact source questions retain wording; adaptations add context for solo practice. All models and translations are authored. No scans or answer keys are distributed.
